target.scope: Local single-user Bun/Hono/React voice dialogue, SQLite writer, LARM integration, queue/scheduler and manual continuity; macOS/Chromium fixture. Real microphone/headphone acceptance and release/distribution excluded.

evidence.observation: Runtime assembles domain services, one SQLite owner, authenticated HTTP routes; boundary checker enforces declared imports.
Input, run and queue job persist before LARM inference; adopted answer and run status settle in one transaction; voice stages track ASR and TTS.
evidence.scope: Primary text and voice paths traced.

evidence.observation: A nonblocking OS lock is acquired before DB opening; WAL, readonly lane and serialized bounded writer are configured.
Profile, connection, claim, expiry, provider and bounded response checks precede inference; simultaneous capability upgrade is regression tested.
evidence.scope: Fixture provider plus prior individual live LARM probe; no real browser voice cycle.

evidence.observation: Playback is invalidated on interruption, delayed audio fetch checks the active turn, and pending session starts can be cancelled.
evidence.scope: Chromium browser fixture and hook tests.

evidence.observation: API Bearer and Origin guards, request schemas, and bounded audio upload apply at ingress.
Jobs use persisted states, leases, deadlines, cancellation and recovery; scheduler scans all active due candidates before applying in-memory deferral.
bun run verify:all exited 0: format, lint, typecheck, 88 backend tests, 25 web tests, web build and one Playwright browser fixture passed in 18.267 seconds.
evidence.scope: macOS 26.6.2, Bun 1.4.2, fixture LARM and synthetic browser microphone; 2026-10-08.

evidence.observation: Playwright exercised actual API, Vite, CLI, text and voice turns, TTS playback and manual bookmark creation through the assembled app.
evidence.scope: Synthetic microphone and fixture provider; one Chromium scenario.

evidence.observation: The project records real microphone/headphone three-turn acceptance and selected failure-display checks as not yet complete.
evidence.scope: Declared limitation, not a runtime failure observation.

evidence.observation: Manual bookmarks now persist through the assembled runtime and are exposed in the Web UI.
evidence.scope: Does not automatically inject bookmarks into model prompts.

evidence.observation: Versions are pinned and domain/full verification commands are defined; no external release pipeline was inspected.
evidence.scope: Dependency update and release process unknown.

claims.statement: The primary fixture path and all configured local checks pass in the reviewed source snapshot.
claims.limitations: Synthetic microphone and fixture provider do not establish real device acceptance.

claims.statement: The assembled backend and Web app expose manual continuity bookmarks.
claims.limitations: Automatic model use of bookmarks is outside this implemented path.

claims.statement: Real microphone and headphone use across three Japanese turns is not yet accepted.
claims.limitations: Requires human-operated hardware and real LARM end-to-end test.

boundaries.rationale: Domain ownership and dependency direction are explicit and checked; runtime assembly stays at the application edge.
boundaries.countercheck: Boundary tests and assembled-app integration were checked after adding continuity.

flow.rationale: Primary accepted input, durable run, external inference and atomic answer adoption are traceable; voice stages are separately recorded.
flow.countercheck: Cancellation, persistence failure and restart tests counter the normal path.

fit.rationale: One local backend and SQLite owner fit the declared single-user macOS prototype; actual hardware envelope remains unmeasured.

contracts.rationale: The primary text, voice and bookmark operations satisfy their fixture-visible contracts, with schemas and state checks at boundaries.

edge_cases.rationale: Upload limits, concurrent connection upgrades, playback interruption, queue saturation and deferred schedule starvation have regression checks.
edge_cases.countercheck: A failed full browser run exposed a selector collision, which was fixed and rerun.

concurrency.rationale: Writer ownership, transactions, queue claims and cancellation ordering are exercised, including the capability-upgrade race.
concurrency.countercheck: Crash-owner, lease loss and concurrent revision tests provide counterchecks.

access.rationale: The local API requires a Bearer token and restricts browser Origin; invalid routes and operations are schema checked.

input_secrets.rationale: LARM credentials remain in the backend; local endpoint validation and bounded input/output reading constrain exposed data.

abuse.rationale: The relevant local abuse paths have token, origin, upload and provider response bounds, and queue capacity rejection.

failure.rationale: Failed writes keep voice audio for retry; stale playback and cancelled inference are not adopted; errors are represented in run/turn state.

recovery.rationale: Restart and crash tests cover queued work, running interruption and writer lock recovery; request IDs deduplicate accepted work.
recovery.countercheck: Old-owner late result and duplicate request tests counter the success-only path.

resilience.rationale: Audio uploads, provider responses, writer queue and background jobs have finite caps and explicit overload behavior.

clarity.rationale: Entry points, contracts and domain ownership let a maintainer trace core behavior and locate verification commands.

change.rationale: The reviewed fixes were local to owning domains and domain/full verification exposed integration regressions.

debt.unknown_reason: No maintenance history for this new project.

duplication.unknown_reason: Repeated contracts outside reviewed paths were not systematically compared.

reuse.unknown_reason: Shared component benefit across multiple independent changes was not established.

abstraction.unknown_reason: Long-term abstraction cost is not observable in a new prototype.

risk_coverage.rationale: Automated checks cover primary paths, concurrency, restart, negative inputs, and a real assembled browser fixture.
risk_coverage.countercheck: Remaining real-device and failure-display cases are explicitly outside verified coverage.

quality.rationale: Tests assert persistent outcomes and real browser effects; new tests detected two races and an integration omission.
quality.countercheck: The first integrated browser run failed on a selector collision and passed after a targeted fix.

automation.rationale: One documented command reproduces static checks, backend/Web tests, build and browser fixture locally.

dependencies.unknown_reason: Pinned versions are visible but update/vulnerability handling has not been inspected.

build_release.unknown_reason: No distribution or update artifact path is in the reviewed prototype scope.

license.unknown_reason: Distribution rights and dependency license review were not established.

budget.unknown_reason: No representative latency or resource budget for real hardware is established.

hot_path.unknown_reason: No representative volume measurement of primary hot paths exists.

measurement.unknown_reason: Fixture and single live probes do not cover tails or growth.

signals.rationale: The UI and API expose turn, run, queue and LARM states and surface common failures; some hardware failure displays remain unaccepted.

lifecycle.unknown_reason: Install/update/removal and real-device recovery were not exercised end to end.

interaction.rationale: Text, voice, CLI and bookmark tasks are exercised in Chromium with fixture services; real device interaction is still unverified.
